title: 30 quart tubs
text: 30 quart tubs. I purchased these to store some things I needed to temporarily store.  I chose this size to control the weight of each box - I tend to overload.  This plan worked great. No one tub was too heavy for me. Stacked them easily.  The handles are comfortable and the lids loosely close (meaning they are not gasketed).  The handles are part of the closure system.  These are great tubs that will last for as long as I need them.  Having said that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Sterilite 30 Quart Ultra Clear Plastic Stackable Storage Tote Container with Latching Lid (36 Pack)
features: LATCH CLIP BIN: Organize your home and keep clutter-free with the Sterilite 30-quart stackable storage containers with white lid and black hinged latch clips
DURABLE: Made in the USA from BPA-free and phthalate-free durable plastic with hinged latch clip lids that keep out bugs, dust, and dirt
STACKABLE: Indexed lids with built-in handles allow for secure stacking of these plastic storage boxes on top of each other
VERSATILE: Ideal for storing light-to-midweight items in your closet, garage, classroom, pantry, bedroom, and more
CLEAR BASE: See-through clear base allows for easy viewing of contents; Outside Dimensions (L x W x H): 18.125 x 12.25 x 11.5 inches; Inside Dimensions (L x W x H): 14 x 9.875 x 10.75 inches
description: Clear some clutter from your home and put away all those larger bulky items taking up space in your closet with this 36-pack of Sterilite 30-Quart Clear Plastic Stackable Storage Bin Totes. These storage totes are crafted out of durable plastic materials, making them ideal for storing heavier items such as boots, accessories, small household tools, and supplies. The clear bases make it easy to see what's inside without having to open them up. The robust latches on the lids offer extra security, so you'll know the lid will always stay attached, and the textured surface makes for a sure grip when carrying. These stackable containers feature an efficient space-saving design with a deep indexed lid surface that allows units to stack as well. With 30 whole quarts of space to work with, the 36-pack of Sterilite Clear Plastic Stackable Storage Bin Totes are perfect for larger, bulkier items, making this tote the perfect storage solution.
